emergence.summary: A single-gene HGD loss-of-function removes homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase, the tyrosine-catabolism enzyme that ring-cleaves homogentisic acid (HGA). HGD normally consumes (clears) HGA; without it HGA ACCUMULATES, is excreted (urine darkening on standing) and, over decades, polymerises and deposits as ochronotic pigment in cartilage/connective tissue -> a destructive arthropathy with cardiac-valve and other involvement -> the HGA burden is driven UP. Read as a released BRAKE on toxic accumulation (HGD clears HGA; LOF releases it -> HGA UP). HGD sits in the SAME tyrosine-catabolism pathway as FAH (tyrosinaemia type 1), one step downstream of 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPD) and upstream of FAH. The kit re-derives the SAME counter-intuitive upstream lever already shipped for tyrosinaemia: nitisinone inhibits the UPSTREAM enzyme HPD so HGA is never formed (an upstream RESTRAINT), rather than restoring HGD -- a clean 'ONE upstream-block lever (restrain HPD / nitisinone), TWO diseases (tyrosinaemia type 1 AND alkaptonuria)' demonstration, because HPD lies upstream of BOTH the HGD lesion (alkaptonuria) and the FAH lesion (tyrosinaemia). The switch-level lever RESTORES HGD (gene/enzyme restoration, investigational; net axis effect lowers the burden -> restrain-coded, the tyrosinaemia convention). Dietary tyrosine/phenylalanine restriction is recorded as adjunct. The gamma read is of the HGD locus switch STRUCTURE (an AT-leaning promoter); the disease lesion is coding (e.g. p.Met368Val and other missense), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: toxic homogentisic-acid burden (HGA accumulation -> ochronotic-pigment deposition) -- the tyrosine-catabolism axis shared with tyrosinaemia, one enzymatic step downstream

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: HGD (homogentisate 1,2-dioxygenase) ring-cleaves homogentisic acid in tyrosine catabolism; it consumes HGA. As a BRAKE on HGA accumulation, its LOF RELEASES the brake -> HGA accumulates and polymerises into ochronotic pigment (toxic). The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the coding lesion (firewall). The pathological axis is the HGA BURDEN (it goes UP), so the corrective levers LOWER it. 3q13.33 (OMIM 607474). NCBI official symbol HGD. Autosomal recessive. Coding lesions (e.g. p.Met368Val).
per_gene.src: Fernandez-Canon 1996 Nat Genet 14:19 (HGO/HGD is the alkaptonuria gene); La Du 1958 J Biol Chem 230:251 (HGD enzyme defect in alkaptonuria)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: inhibit the UPSTREAM HPD step so homogentisate is never formed -> lower the HGA burden (the same upstream-block lever used in tyrosinaemia, here applied to alkaptonuria)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] HGA-lowering magnitude / ochronosis outcome not derived from sequence
levers.src: Introne 2011 Mol Genet Metab 103:307 (nitisinone lowers urinary HGA in AKU); Ranganath 2020 Ann Rheum Dis (SONIA-2); nitisinone EMA-approved for alkaptonuria 2020

levers.push_direction: restore HGD so accumulating homogentisate is cleaved again -> lower the HGA burden (definitive); net axis effect LOWERS the burden
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree/durability of restored HGD activity not derived from sequence
levers.src: preclinical HGD-restoration models (no approved gene therapy)

falsifiers.claim: HGD LOF (released brake) raises the homogentisic-acid burden (axis UP)
falsifiers.falsifier: an HGD null allele that LOWERED urinary/plasma homogentisic acid would refute the released-brake direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary / plasma homogentisic acid stratified by HGD genotype

falsifiers.claim: blocking the upstream HPD step (nitisinone) is the CORRECTIVE direction (lowers the HGA burden)
falsifiers.falsifier: if inhibiting HPD RAISED or failed to lower homogentisic acid, the restrain-HPD lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: urinary homogentisic acid response to HPD inhibition
